Since it is not possible to refuse the game that was set up when entering the barrier, vampire extermination people who have been in battle are also taken off one after another, and Doralck and Ronald are also involved.

Ronald and his friends, suddenly summoned by him, are ordered to capture the vampires who have escaped from the center. The fleeing vampire was a parasite-type nasty opponent with a strong fascinating pheromone.
